tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What Car Rental Brain measures, how fresh it is, and which airports/countries are covered. Use first when unsure whether a place is covered.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Airports we measure, with the typical rental price per day. Filter by country. Use to find an airport id or to list what is covered in a country.

tools.name: airport_costs
tools.description: The true cost of hiring a car at one airport: per-day price for the car alone, with a second driver, with full cover, automatic, no-deposit (from + typical); by pick-up month; second-driver fees; deposits; debit-card acceptance; desk closing times and out-of-hours fees; policies; Brain's pick per ca

tools.name: compare_airports
tools.description: Rank airports by real cost (car only / with driver / with cover), typical deposit, debit-card friendliness or late desk hours. Use for 'where in Spain is car hire cheapest in March?' or 'which airport is best for a debit card?'

tools.name: supplier_terms
tools.description: Per supplier at an airport: typical price per day, second-driver fee, full-cover price, deposit held, whether the desk takes a debit card, and customers' desk review scores. Use when the person is choosing between suppliers at one airport or asks about a named supplier.

tools.name: recommend_rental
tools.description: ONE call for a car-hire question at one airport: the usual total for the person's dates split into rental, second-driver fee, cover and out-of-hours fee (deposit shown separately as a card hold), the suppliers that usually suit their needs with each requirement marked meets / unverified and its evid

tools.name: desks_open
tools.description: Which car-hire desks at an airport are still open when the person lands: each company's own measured closing time, sorted into open / closes within 45 minutes of landing / already closed, the 24-hour desks, the typical late pick-up fee and a search link timed to reach the desk. Use for late or night

tools.name: build_search_link
tools.description: A link for the PERSON to open: live prices for their exact dates and needs, ranked by the total they will actually pay, where they can book.
